// --- Kernel entry point ---
extern "C" __aicore__ __attribute__((always_inline)) void kernel_entry(__gm__ int64_t* args)
{
#if !defined(__CPU_SIM) && !defined(__COSTMODEL)
    // Reset AI Core atomic mode inherited from a prior kernel.
    set_atomic_none();
#endif

#if defined(__DAV_CUBE__) && !defined(__CPU_SIM) && !defined(__COSTMODEL)
    // Start cube tasks in FP32 mode, independent of a prior task's HF32 setting.
    set_ctrl(sbitset0(get_ctrl(), pto::MAD_MODE_BIT));
#endif

    // Read logical SPMD block identity from runtime dispatch payload
    int32_t __pypto_spmd_block_idx = get_block_idx(args);
    int32_t __pypto_spmd_block_num = get_block_num(args);

    // Unpack tensor: source__ssa_v0
    __gm__ Tensor* source__ssa_v0_tensor = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ Tensor*>(args[0]);
    __gm__ bfloat16_t* source__ssa_v0 = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ bfloat16_t*>(source__ssa_v0_tensor->buffer.addr) + source__ssa_v0_tensor->start_offset;

    // Unpack tensor: weight__ssa_v0
    __gm__ Tensor* weight__ssa_v0_tensor = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ Tensor*>(args[1]);
    __gm__ bfloat16_t* weight__ssa_v0 = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ bfloat16_t*>(weight__ssa_v0_tensor->buffer.addr) + weight__ssa_v0_tensor->start_offset;

    // Unpack tensor: target__ssa_v0
    __gm__ Tensor* target__ssa_v0_tensor = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ Tensor*>(args[2]);
    __gm__ bfloat16_t* target__ssa_v0 = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ bfloat16_t*>(target__ssa_v0_tensor->buffer.addr) + target__ssa_v0_tensor->start_offset;

    // Unpack scalar: num_tokens__ssa_v0
    union { uint64_t u64; int32_t val; } num_tokens__ssa_v0_conv;
    num_tokens__ssa_v0_conv.u64 = args[3];
    int32_t num_tokens__ssa_v0 = num_tokens__ssa_v0_conv.val;

    // Extract dynamic dim: rows__ssa_v0
    int64_t rows__ssa_v0 = static_cast<int64_t>(target__ssa_v0_tensor->shapes[0]);

    // Forward to ptoas-generated function
    validate_baseline_incore_0(source__ssa_v0, weight__ssa_v0, target__ssa_v0, num_tokens__ssa_v0, rows__ssa_v0, __pypto_spmd_block_idx, __pypto_spmd_block_num);
}
